emails.subject: PEP Rev A input - Engineering and design management summary (re REQ-003-epc-proj)
emails.body:
Rajan,

Below is the engineering and design management input for PEP Rev A, consistent with the Engineering Execution Plan and Deliverables List (HEL001-G000-E-&PRC-00001-A) and the review periods agreed at the Kick-off Meeting.

1. DESIGN STAGES
- Stage 1, Design Basis (A310, 15 Dec 2026 - 20 Jan 2027): site data, grid code requirements, standards, load and climatic criteria, PV/BESS/220 kV basis. Submitted to OWE as a report for review.
- Stage 2, Basic Design (to M04, 15 Mar 2027): single line diagrams, plant layout (PV1-PV4, BES, PSS, GSS, TL1), DC/AC sizing and energy yield basis, earthing and lightning concept, MV/LV cable concept, BESS and substation concept, SCADA architecture, preliminary civil and foundation concept, technical specifications for long-lead packages.
- Stage 3, Detailed Design (from M04): issued-for-construction drawings and calculations released per area (PV1-PV4, BES, PSS, GSS, TL1) in line with M05 mobilisation (1 Mar 2027) and M08 first piles (12 Apr 2027); piling and foundation packages are released first.
- Stage 4, Vendor documents and As-Built: vendor drawings and FAT documents reviewed within the same cycle; as-built set compiled progressively and issued before PAC (M14, 31 May 2028).

2. REVIEW CYCLE WITH OWE
- Drawings, calculations and specifications: 10 working days per OWE review, comments consolidated by Sophie Laurent. Plans and procedures 14 days; RFIs/TQs 5 working days; method statements and ITPs 7 working days.
- HEP responds to comments within 5 working days and resubmits; a second review is planned at 5 working days. Planning assumption: one full review plus one short re-review per Basic Design package.
- Deemed-approval wording is to be confirmed by Thomas Becker from the Contract; until then I plan on written approval or Code B/C status only.
- Document numbering and status codes follow the Document Control and Numbering Procedure; Nilufar Yusupova logs all submissions and review dates in the design document register.

3. BASIC DESIGN ROUTE TO M04 (15 Mar 2027)
- Design Basis report issued to OWE by 20 Jan 2027, OWE comments back about 3 Feb, approved Design Basis by about 10 Feb.
- Topographic survey (A210, to 25 Jan) and geotechnical report (A220, to 20 Feb) feed the layout, foundation and earthing concepts. Preliminary layout and SLDs can proceed in parallel on desktop data; foundations and pile design cannot be finalised before the geotech report.
- Basic Design package submitted to OWE by 26 Feb 2027 at the latest. With a 10-working-day review, OWE comments are due about 12 Mar, which leaves 1 working day to M04. Any comment round after submission therefore threatens M04.
- Proposed mitigation: staged submission in 3 tranches (electrical/grid and SLDs by 12 Feb; layout and BESS/substation concept by 19 Feb; civil and foundation concept after geotech by 26 Feb), so OWE reviews run concurrently and comments are cleared before 15 Mar.
- Grid studies and UzGridCo technical requirements (Ulugbek Mirzaev) are needed for protection and 220 kV interface design. I have not yet seen the UzGridCo technical conditions and will ask for them through the correct channel.

4. KEY RISKS AND ASSUMPTIONS
- Geotech report slips beyond 20 Feb: Basic Design civil package slips day for day; piling start M08 at risk.
- OWE review exceeding 10 working days or multiple comment rounds on the Design Basis.
- Late land documents (A110) affecting layout fixity and the construction permit file (M07, 20 Mar 2027).
- Vendor data (modules, inverters, trackers, BESS) needed by February for the layout; vendor award timing is outside my control and I need Mehmet Yildiz's dates.
- Scope growth after Design Basis approval will be handled through design change control and Contracts, not absorbed into the Basic Design.

5. NEXT STEPS AND DEPENDENCIES
- By 8 Dec: first design document register and design package timing for the construction permit file (action from the Kick-off Meeting), which I will issue separately.
- By 15 Dec: Design Basis kick-off aligned with A310 start.
- I need from Planning the logic ties between A210/A220/A310 and the Basic Design submission in the L2/L3 baseline, and from Supply Chain the vendor data dates.

Please feel free to lift sections 1-3 directly into PEP Rev A; I can compress them into a table if you prefer. Call me if you want to discuss the geotech float before the baseline goes to OWE.

Regards,
Elena Petrova
Engineering Manager, Helios EPC LLC

requests.what: Please confirm in the L2/L3 baseline the logic ties from A210, A220 and A310 to the Basic Design submission (target 26 Feb 2027), the OWE review window of 10 working days, and M04 on 15 Mar 2027; review whether A220 can deliver a phased or preliminary geotechnical report earlier than 20 Feb 2027.

Please provide the planned award and technical data dates for modules, inverter stations, trackers and BESS so that I can fix vendor data inputs for the Basic Design layout (needed by mid-February 2027).
